text.body: || haṃsopaniṣat || oṃ pūrṇamadaḥ pūrṇamidaṃ pūrṇāt pūrṇamudacyate | pūrṇasya pūrṇamādāya pūrṇamevāvaśiṣyate || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || gautama uvāca | bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada | brahmavidyāprabodho hi kenopāyena jāyate || 1 || sanatkumāra uvāca | vicārya sarvavedeṣu mataṃ jñātvā pinākinaḥ | pārvatyā kathitaṃ tattvaṃ śṛṇu gautama tanmama || 2 || anākhyeyamidaṃ guhyaṃ yogināṃ kośasannibham | haṃsasyākṛtivistāraṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 3 || atha haṃsaparamahaṃsanirṇayaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | brahmacāriṇe śāntāya dāntāya gurubhaktāya | haṃsahaṃseti sadā dhyāyan || 4 || sarveṣu deheṣu vyāpto vartate | yathā hyagniḥ kāṣṭheṣu tileṣu tailamiva taṃ viditvā mṛtyumatyeti || 5 || gudamavaṣṭabhyādhārādvāyumutthāpyasvādhiṣṭhānaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya maṇipūrakaṃ ca gatvā anāhatamatikramya viśuddhau prāṇānnirudhyājñāmanudhyāyanbrahmarandhraṃ dhyāyan trimātro'hamityeva sarvadā paśyatyanākāraśca bhavati || 6 || eṣo'sau paramahaṃso bhānukoṭipratīkāśo yenedaṃ sarvaṃ vyāptam || 7 || tasyāṣṭadhā vṛttirbhavati | pūrvadale puṇye matiḥ | āgneye nidrālasyādayo bhavanti | yāmye kraurye matiḥ | nairṛte pāpe manīṣā | vāruṇyāṃ krīḍā | vāyavyāṃ gamanādau buddhiḥ | saumye ratiprītiḥ | īśānye dravyādānam | madhye vairāgyam | kesare jāgradavasthā | karṇikāyāṃ svapnam | liṅge suṣuptiḥ | padmatyāge turīyam | yadā haṃse nādo vilīno bhavati tat turīyātītam || 8 || atho nādamādhārādbrahmarandhraparyantaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ | sa vai brahma paramātmetyucyate || 1 || atha haṃsa ṛṣiḥ | avyaktagāyatrī chandaḥ | paramahaṃso devatā | hamiti bījam | sa iti śaktiḥ | so'hamiti kīlakam || 10 || ṣaṭ saṅkhyayā ahorātrayorekaviṃśatisahasrāṇi ṣaṭ śatānyadhikāni bhavanti | sūryāya somāya nirañjanāya nirābhāsāyatanusūkṣmaṃ pracodayāditi || 11 || agnīṣomābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ hṛdayādyaṅganyāsakaranyāsau bhavataḥ || 12 || evaṃ kṛtvā hṛdaye aṣṭadale haṃsātmānaṃ dhyāyet || 13 || agnīṣomau pakṣāvoṅkāraḥ śiro ukāro bindu strinetraṃ mukhaṃ rudro rudrāṇī caraṇau | dvividhaṃ kaṇṭhataḥ kuryādityunmanāḥ ajapopasaṃhāra ityabhidhīyate || 14 || evaṃ haṃsavaśāttasmānmano haṃso vicāryate || 15 || asyeva japakoṭyāṃ nādamanubhavati evaṃ sarvaṃ haṃsavaśānnādo daśavidho jāyate | ciṇīti prathamaḥ | ciñciṇīti dvitīyaḥ | ghaṇṭānādastṛtīyaḥ | śaṅkhanādaścaturthaḥ | pañcamastantrīnādaḥ | ṣaṣṭhastālanādaḥ | saptamo veṇunādaḥ | aṣṭamo mṛdaṅganādaḥ | navamo bherīnādaḥ | daśamo meghanādaḥ || 16 || navamaṃ parityajya daśamamevābhyaset || 17 || prathame ciñciṇīgātraṃ dvitīye gātrabhañjanam | tṛtīye khedanaṃ yāti caturthe kampate śiraḥ || 18 || pañcame sravate tālu ṣaṣṭhe'mṛtaniṣevaṇam | saptame gūḍhavijñānaṃ parā vācā tathāṣṭame || 19 || adṛśyaṃ navame dehaṃ divyaṃ cakṣustathāmalam | daśame paramaṃ brahma bhavedbrahmātmasannidhau || 20 || tasminmano vilīyate manasi saṅkalpavikalpe dagdhe puṇyapāpe sadāśivaḥ śaktyātmā sarvatrāvasthitaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ śuddho buddho nityo nirañjanaḥ śāntaḥ prakāśata iti vedānuvacanaṃ bhavatītyupaniṣat || 21 || oṃ pūrṇamadaḥ pūrṇamidaṃ pūrṇāt pūrṇamudacyate | pūrṇasya pūrṇamādāya pūrṇamevāvaśiṣyate || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || || iti haṃsopaniṣatsamāptā ||
